summary: PARITY-1 v7 mobile-only worked-examples parity sweep. Tested Statement Detail (rich, cathy@example.com) and Invoice Detail on the Expo web preview at 390x844. Statement Detail passes all parity criteria (renders DecoderResultView via decoder-result-v2 + statement-decoder-view, NO SmartAISummary / NO ALERT-WARNING labels, has decoder-persona-hero, decoder-plain-english-summary, decoder-summary-banner with all 4 tiles, decoder-anomaly-panel with High/Medium/Low chips, ai-anomaly-disclaimer per card, decoder-stream-breakdown, decoder-full-table, decoder-download-bar with all 3 buttons Share this decode / Download CSV / Download PDF). CRITICAL parity defect on Invoice Detail: the mobile Invoice detail screen still renders the SmartAISummary 'SMART SUMMARY / Your Wayly Insight' card ABOVE InvoiceResultView, exactly the mobile-invented block PARITY-1 v7 was supposed to remove. InvoiceResultView itself is compliant (inv1-result + banner + verdict + Wayly Summary title-case card + Issue Register with per-issue Refund and What-to-do, no ISSUES TO REVIEW / TIER light list / What to check before paying / things to check / Checks run). Did not exercise the two AI Tools flows end-to-end because they consume the free-tool cooldown and this critical defect already blocks the invoice worked-example.

Good.

DecoderResultView (mobile) matches web contract: severity chips are HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW (uppercase text on colored pill, same as web), ai-anomaly-disclaimer sits inside every anomaly-card-*, download bar has all three testIDs (decoder-share-pdf-btn / decoder-download-csv-btn / decoder-download-pdf-btn).

Severity chip text is rendered uppercase (sev.toUpperCase()) which matches web's CSS-uppercased lowercase source strings — visually identical.

rca of the issue: PARITY-1 v7 rewrote statement/[id].tsx to remove SmartAISummary but the sibling refactor of invoice/[id].tsx left the SmartAISummary 'invoice-detail' block intact (lines 7 + 88-100). Fix: delete the import on line 7 and the <SmartAISummary pageKey="invoice-detail" .../> JSX block (lines 88-100). Reproduction: login as cathy@example.com on mobile preview → tap Invoices tab → tap any invoice → observe 'SMART SUMMARY / Your Wayly Insight' card above the inv1-result view.
